name: Olivier Pirotton
bio:
Directeur Financier des filiales congolaises du groupe TEXAF  · Experienced CFO with 10 years as CFO of Texaf subsidiaries in DRC (complex environment) after 15 years within PwC Belgium as a financial auditor (former CPA) in charge of the audit of Belgian subsidiaries of multinational corporations (Bayer, Colgate, … ), local SME or even trade unions . 

Proven track record in the field of management, people management, dealing with banks as well as (re)organising and (re)structuring the activities of a finance / accounting department.

Within Texaf DRC subsidiaries, besides the “normal” finance topics, I’m in charge of the IT aspects (with external supplier of course) and I really appreciate to share with other departments (legal aspects, commercial, production, technical, HR, …) in order to “feel the business” and therefore being able to take appropriate decisions.

name: Moses Nyabanda
bio:
Strategy | Finance & Corporate Governance  · I have 22 years of deep and broad experience in delivering sustainable strategic value for organizations throughout my consulting career.

Before joining Equity Group, I was the Managing Director and Country Senior Partner for PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) in Rwanda and a member of PwC's Eastern Africa leadership team. I have a proven track record of leading effective teams, strategic planning, driving business growth, and delivering impactful solutions to businesses and governments in Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, and the United Kingdom. I've worked closely with Executive Teams, Boards of Directors, and Senior Government officials to co-create trusted solutions to business challenges and have developed strong relationships and networks across different markets over the years.
